---
name: trace-cdag-sources
description: Trace an acceptance inventory capability to its official web sources when checking the Codex App gateway in the local fixture workspace.
metadata:
  short-description: Trace gateway inventory claims to official sources
---

Select the capability relevant to the user's question from the acceptance inventory MCP, and inspect its source URLs. Open the source and verify the specific claim; use page finding and link following when the source points to another document.

Separate an official interface contract, the fixed native implementation, and an observed App result. An inventory entry is a lead, not an acceptance result. Cite the retrieved page next to the claim it supports. This plugin does not provide model responses, run an agent loop, or grant extra permissions.
